title: Servio OAuth Client Registration
description: Full OAuth 2.0 client registration record for a pre-registered AI agent. These records are stored server-side and determine which AI agents can initiate the OAuth flow without manual admin registration.

client_id.description: Unique identifier for the AI agent. Used as the client_id parameter in OAuth requests.

client_name.description: Human-readable display name for the AI agent.

redirect_uris.description: Allowed redirect URIs for this client. The OOB URI is always accepted. Localhost URIs may be included for development.

allowed_scopes.description: OAuth scopes this client is permitted to request. read is always included. write/delete/admin must be explicitly allowed.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when this client record was created.
